No. Cart1 strikes ball1 at 0.55 s, ball1 descends the ramp and hits pendulum1 at 1.51 s, and pendulum1 strikes door1 near its 40° stop. Door1 hits block1 and reaches its nominal 70° stop, briefly overshooting to 71.2°.

Block1 travels roughly 0.30 m, but then strikes both low side rails of `domino1_guide` and stops without touching domino1. Domino1 remains upright, lever1 never rotates, and ball2 stays on the lever; nothing passes through ring1 or touches cart2. Ball2’s initial contact with the lever is consistent with being carried, but it is not a launch.

The correction below removes the obstructing domino side rails, retains its toe stop and the wide lever striker, and modestly increases the door assist. This revision has not yet been simulation-validated.
